CustomField.description: Per-student flag indicating that the student lives at the same address as Guardian 1. Defaults TRUE: most students live with Guardian 1, so the create-screen "Student lives at a different address" checkbox (an inverted view of this field) starts unchecked and the separate Student Address section stays hidden until the parent indicates otherwise. When true, the Guardian 1 address is treated as the student's address (and is copied to the student record on edit).
CustomField.label: Lives With Guardian 1
